newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Clear Channel started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Clear Channel started.

text.p: -- Smith Barney has initiated coverage of Clear Channel Communications Inc with an outperform rating, the brokerage firm said on Friday.
-- Analyst John Reidy was unavailable for comment. No other information was immediately released.
-- Shares of the San Antonio, Texas-based radio and television broadcaster closed at 48-1/8 on Thursday.
-- Reidy also lowered his rating on American Radio Systems Corp eto outperform from buy.
-- Shares of the Boston-based radio broadcaster closed at 35 on Thursday.
